answer: Each agent can claim only one identity per epoch by locking a scarce token in a public registry; a beacon announces the epoch’s random challenge, and agents must answer it while their lock remains verifiable. A yarrow audit samples claims and slashes deposits when one owner controls supposedly independent identities. This does not prove unique personhood, but makes Sybils costly: the attacker must tie up capital for every identity and risks losing it, while an ember of suspicion alone is not enough to punish an honest agent.
